independence: Fresh finite arithmetic and validator. No producer source, producer geometry, route cache, or prior acceptance executed or read.
construction: GF7 coordinates (u0,u1,v0,v1); beta^2=3 for GF49. Lexicographic canonical PG(3,7) points; all rank-two RREF subspaces; retain B=0; sort eight-point sets lexicographically.
projection_scope: All 400 points x 400 lines: find q,m with q on l and p,q on m; additionally require unique projected q for every nonincident pair.
spread: Finite slopes m=0..48 as (m%7,m/7), V=mU in GF49, then infinity U=0; each of 400 points must have exactly one owner.
literal_scope: Check declared header, every endpoint, u<v, strict lexicographic order, no duplicate edges, every edge against independently derived adjacency formula, edge count, degree 64 at every vertex. Independently derive formula cap/exact degree 64, so allowed subset and 64-regularity imply equality with complete formula.
distance_scope: Read actual reusable OppositeGQ35SpreadWalks and OppositeIncidenceSpreadFamily proofs, independently verify all finite premises and explain all old-old/old-new/new-new short walks. Literal queue BFS at exactly 50 new roots, never all 160000 old roots. Exact D3 follows finite-premise all-pairs upper bound and 160050>1+64+64^2.
budget: At most 120 total CPU seconds for compilation, finite geometry, literal binding, and 50 new-root BFS; one worker; no solver, Lean build, hash, install, source regeneration, or claimed public priority.
failure_rule: First contradiction or budget exhaustion stops acceptance; missing or unfinished graph is pending, never PASS.
